units.source_text: 且说源氏近来很少到六条院来，所以这次来了不好意思立刻回二条院去，

en.t: Now Genji had rarely come to Rokujo-in lately, so after coming this time he felt too embarrassed to return immediately to Nijo-in,

units.source_text: 但是心里时时刻刻挂念紫夫人的病。

en.t: but in his heart he was constantly worried about Lady Murasaki's illness.

units.source_text: 忽然有人来报道：“夫人昏死过去了！”

en.t: Suddenly someone came to report, "My lady has fallen into a deathlike faint!"

units.source_text: 源氏一闻此言，万事都顾不得，

en.t: The moment Genji heard this, he could think of nothing else,

units.source_text: 但觉心头一团漆黑，连忙赶回二条院去。

en.t: and felt only darkness closing over his heart as he hurried back to Nijo-in.

units.source_text: 他一路上心慌意乱，来到二条院附近，

en.t: He was frantic with anxiety all the way, and when he reached the vicinity of Nijo-in,

units.source_text: 但见大路上的人也都惊惶骚扰。

en.t: he saw that even the people on the main road were frightened and in turmoil.

units.source_text: 殿内传出一片哭声。

en.t: A wave of weeping came from inside the residence.

units.source_text: 他觉得这光景很不祥，就茫茫然地走进殿内，

en.t: Feeling that this scene was deeply ominous, he walked dazedly into the residence,

units.source_text: 众侍女告诉他说：“这几天病状已经略见好转，想不到今天忽然变得这样了！”

en.t: and the serving women told him, "Her condition had shown some improvement these past few days; we never expected it to suddenly become like this today!"

units.source_text: 所有的侍女都哭着要追随夫人同去，骚乱之状不可言喻。

en.t: All the serving women were crying that they wanted to follow their lady in death, and the confusion was beyond description.

units.source_text: 祈祷坛已经拆毁，僧众正在纷纷退出，只有几个亲信的和尚还不曾走。

en.t: The prayer altar had already been dismantled, and the monks were filing out one after another; only a few trusted monks had not yet left.

units.source_text: 源氏见此光景，心知已到最后关头，悲伤之情无可比拟。

en.t: Seeing this, Genji knew in his heart that the final moment had come, and his grief was beyond compare.

units.source_text: 他说：“虽然已经昏死过去，定是鬼魂作祟，你们不要只管号哭！”

en.t: He said, "Though she has fallen into a deathlike faint, it must be the work of a spirit; do not simply wail and cry!"

units.source_text: 他叫众人镇静下来，便向神佛宣立宏誓大愿。

en.t: He made everyone calm down, then declared great vows before the gods and Buddhas.

units.source_text: 又把一切道行高深的法师召集拢来，叫他们再做祈祷。

en.t: He also gathered all the priests of profound spiritual practice and ordered them to perform the prayers again.

units.source_text: 僧众向神佛告道：“即使命定阳寿已尽，亦请暂时宽缓。

en.t: The monks appealed to the gods and Buddhas, "Even if her allotted span of life is fated to be exhausted, please grant a temporary reprieve.

units.source_text: 不动尊曾有誓约，至少也得延迟六月。”

en.t: Fudo Myoo once made a vow; at the very least, let it be delayed by six months."

units.source_text: 诸位法师振作精神，诚心祈祷，头上好像冒出黑烟。

en.t: The priests roused their spirits and prayed with all sincerity, until black smoke seemed to rise from their heads.

units.source_text: 源氏心情缭乱，想道：“总得再见一面才好。

en.t: Genji's mind was in turmoil, and he thought, "I must see her once more, whatever happens.

units.source_text: 如此匆匆瞑目，使我不能送死，真乃抱恨终天了！”

en.t: If she closes her eyes so suddenly and leaves me unable to see her off at the end, I will carry this regret forever!"

units.source_text: 他悲恸之极，愤不欲生。

en.t: He was overcome with the deepest grief, so anguished and enraged that he no longer wished to live.

units.source_text: 旁人睹此情景，伤心可想而知。

en.t: One can imagine how heartbroken the people around him were when they saw this scene.
